messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU memory pressure spike in eu-west-1a. Observed: repeated CUDA alloc failures (NVML) and kvcache OOMs across pool gpu-pool-eu-west-1a. Auto-pager fired.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC-20260317-EUW triggered (sev2). Notifying on-call: @devon. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-20260317-EUW

devon: oncall here — acknowleging in PD, jumping in. :point_up:

devon: quick triage: OOMs started at 00:02 UTC, error rate 30% for inference requests on pool gpu-pool-eu-west-1a. Trying immediate mitigation: temporarily scale +2 nodes and enable fallback routing.

devon: running scale command now:
```
infractl scale gpu-pool-eu-west-1a --add 2 --reason "oom surge auto-mitigation"
```

maria: any customer impact seen? which customers are hitting 5xx?

devon: checking logs + dashboards — looks like 3 customers (cust-alpha, beta-saas, internal-canary) saw increased 5xx and latency. Autoshedder has started evicting heavy KV-cache sessions.

sam: enabling model fallback route for affected traffic: routing policy -> prefer model_variant: small-quant-v2 for low-latency requests. Pushing config: 
```
route add --pool eu-west-1a --match "model in (large-chat) and latency>200ms" --to small-quant-v2 --ttl 10m
```

incident-bot: Autopager attempted fallback to small-quant-v2 but several inflight requests still hit alloc failures. Eviction loop detected for kvcache shards 5-7.

devon: drained node gpu-euw-1a-10 from pool (cordon + drain) to stop noisy neighbor.
```
kubectl cordon gpu-euw-1a-10 && kubectl drain gpu-euw-1a-10 --ignore-daemonsets --force
```

devon: after drain: OOM counts dropping ~70% in last 60s, 5xx rate down to ~8% for affected customers. Scaling completed.

maria: thanks. I'll open a short customer-facing status update and loop in CSMs. Suggested message: "We observed a GPU memory pressure event in eu-west-1a which impacted inference for a small subset of customers. We've routed traffic and scaled capacity; services are recovering." Thoughts?

kyle: +1. Also suggest we mention mitigation steps and advise ETA ~15-30m for full recovery. I can ping CSMs and post to #status.

sam: leaving the fallback route active for 20m, then we'll revert if stable. I'll also queue a node reprovision for gpu-euw-1a-10 (possible driver/kernel drift).

devon: handoff: I'm going to stay on for 30m to watch stable. If it recurs, escalate to infra-team. PD incident updated with mitigation notes. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC-20260317-EUW acknowledged by devon. Current status: mitigated (partial). Escalation suspended.

maria: creating post-incident ticket with logs and KV-shard eviction trace and assigning to eng-runtime + infra. Noting customer list and timeline.

devon: quick notes for postmortem: suspect kvcache fragmentation after recent release 2026.03.14 (kvcache v1.9.2). Will attach heap traces.

kyle: thanks team. I'll draft the initial status page and coordinate CSM updates. If everyone is good, I'll close PD after 1hr if stable.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Auto-pager closed by manual ack and mitigation. Record: autopager->scale->drain->fallback.

devon: closing thread here but keeping watch. ping me in thread if the 5xx rises again. :coffee:
